messages:
eval-bot: NIGHTLY EVAL ALERT — rwd-v2-small-int8 (quant8) 
  promptset: safety-long-context 
  hallucination_rate: baseline 0.7% -> 6.2% (today) 
  fail_count: 31/500 
  report: https://internal.eval/reports/1769876543 (full diffs + examples) :rotating_light:

maria: saw the alert, investigating. Reproduced one failing example locally.

alex: FYI we pushed runtime/kv-pack-optim (commit abc123) to hosted canary this morning at ~07:10 PT.

sam: tagging eng-runtime — that kv-pack change repacks int8 KV tiles into 64-token tiles to save memory. Quick hypothesis: packing logic miscomputes offsets when inputs include trailing padding or variable-length prefixes.

maria: repro steps: run nightly harness on that promptset with the quantized runtime image -> bad completions (hallucinated facts in last paragraph). When I forced seq_len <= 1024 it looked okay, but >1024 triggers it.

leo: I pulled attention maps from the failing run. They show attention shifted left by ~64 tokens for several heads — looks like K/V misalignment, not a decoding param issue.

sam: found the suspicious line in kv packing: 
```
// simplified snippet
int kv_offset = (seq_len / TILE) * TILE; // TILE == 64
// should be kv_offset = seq_len; // packing expects exact seq length in tokens
```
This causes an off-by-chunk offset when seq_len is not a multiple of TILE — downstream indexing then reads stale keys.

maria: confirmed locally - swapping to kv_offset = seq_len fixes generations in the harness for all failing prompts. Runs with padding also pass.

alex: immediate actions?

sam: starting rollback on hosted canary pool now, rolling previous runtime image. ETA ~20m. Opening hotfix PR to revert packing optimization and add regression tests: PR #4521.

jia: do we have customers impacted? Any SLAs to notify?

karen: no high-severity external incidents reported yet. We'll keep monitoring for customer complaints; I'll prep an incident ops note in the tracker.

maria: postmortem notes / root cause (short): runtime kv-packing optimization introduced a tile-based offset computation that is incompatible with existing KV indexing semantics for quantized models. For sequences whose length isn't a multiple of the packing tile, K/V reads used an incorrect offset leading to misaligned attention and hallucinations on long-context promptsets.

sam: mitigation checklist: 
- rollback runtime image on hosted/dedicated pools (in progress)
- merge hotfix PR to restore correct kv_offset behavior (#4521)
- add unit tests that exercise padded sequences and mismatched tile sizes in CI (eng-runtime)
- add a nightly gating rule: quantized runtime rollouts must pass full 'safety-long-context' promptset before canary->prod (eng-releases)
- add preflight eval that runs long-context promptset against any runtime change touching KV layout (eng-ml + eng-runtime)

alex: adding gating rule now to release checklist and halting other runtime rollouts until PR merged and nightly passes.

maria: I'll add tokenizer/version pin to the harness to ensure no confounding tokenization drift. Also will add a small set of 'anchor' long-context prompts to the CI smoke tests.

leo: rollback finished on canary pool at 07:35 PT. Monitoring.

eval-bot: UPDATED nightly eval — current run after rollback shows hallucination_rate back to 0.9% (still running full suite). https://internal.eval/reports/1769876920

maria: follow-ups (owners): 
- eng-runtime: fix + unit tests (sam)
- eng-releases: enforce gating + pause rollouts (alex)
- eng-ml: add CI anchors + tokenizer pin (maria)
- eng-sre: incident tracker + customer watch (karen)

sam: pushed hotfix branch and PR link: https://git.internal/rw/runtime/pull/4521, includes patch and test vectors.

alex: thanks everyone. We'll keep this thread for the roll-forward once PR is merged and nightly green. :thumbsup:
